title: Windows Vault credential store
whyItMatters: The Vault holds encrypted web and Windows credentials. Its size shows how many secrets the account saved that need rotating before handover.
source: DPAPI and Credential Manager reference: Windows Vault at %LOCALAPPDATA%/Microsoft/Vault - https://www.windowsforensics.app/en/artifacts/dpapi-credential-manager
notes: Contains per-GUID vault folders with encrypted .vcrd files. No vault file is opened or decrypted; a roaming copy under APPDATA is not covered here.
